description:
Wearfit HK10 Pro Max Ultra 2 smartwatch is made for people who want a big 2.04" AMOLED always‑on display, clear Bluetooth calling, and all‑day fitness tracking in one premium-looking watch. The ultra‑bright screen stays sharp outdoors, so you can read notifications, caller ID, and workout stats at a glance. Take calls from your wrist with the built‑in mic and speaker—perfect when your phone is in your bag, on charge, or mounted for navigation.

Track heart rate, SpO2, sleep, and steps to stay on top of daily recovery and routine. Choose sports modes for walks, runs, cycling, and gym sessions, then personalize the look with custom watch faces. With IP67 splash/sweat resistance and comfortable interchangeable 49mm straps, it’s ready for workdays, workouts, and weekends. Pair it with Android or iPhone via the Wearfit Pro app and keep your day moving without constantly reaching for your phone.

features: 2.04" AMOLED always‑on display (420×486): Big, vivid screen that stays readable outdoors for calls, messages, and workout stats.
Bluetooth calling with mic + speaker: Answer calls from your wrist when your phone is in your pocket, bag, or on charge.
Voice assistant support: Use voice commands for quick actions like reminders and basic phone controls (features may vary by phone/app).
24/7 wellness tracking: Heart rate, SpO2, sleep, and steps to help you stay aware of daily habits and recovery trends (not medical-grade).
Multiple sports modes: Track walking, running, cycling and workouts for motivation and simple performance insights.
Smart notifications: Get call, SMS and app alerts on the watch so you check your phone less during work and travel.
IP67 splash & sweat resistance: Made for gym sessions, rain splashes and daily wear (not for swimming or hot showers).
Custom watch faces + 49mm interchangeable straps: Switch the look easily—sporty for workouts, clean for office days.
Magnetic USB charging: Simple charging setup with the included magnetic cable for quick top-ups.
Android & iOS compatibility: Works with Android 5.0+ and iOS 10.0+ through the Wearfit Pro app.
